title: llz-cluster-foundation values
description: Root-strict schema: every top-level key is declared, so a typo (e.g. `storageClassPatchr:`) is REJECTED AT RENDER instead of silently activating nothing. Nested objects stay permissive on purpose — the value here is catching the silent no-op, not freezing every knob. Add nested constraints only where a wrong value is as silent as a wrong key.

image.description: Image used by this chart's Jobs/CronJobs (coreDNS restart, sc-default-patcher).

syncWaves.description: Per-resource Argo sync-wave assignments. Load-bearing ordering — see values.yaml.

namespaces.description: Namespaces this chart creates (wave -20, before anything targets them).

networkPolicies.description: Baseline default-deny + allow policies. Each scar here prevents a specific convergence wedge.

storageClassPatcher.description: Keeps exactly one default StorageClass (promote desiredDefault, demote LKE's).
